title: A must-do tour in Barcelona
text: If you like riding ebikes and want to see another side of Barcelona outside of the city — this ride with Marina is an absolute must. A beautiful ride up the mountain made easy with an ebike. The reward is an amazing view of the city. Marina made sure we were always safe on the ride. An absolutely terrific and must-do tour if you're in Barcelona!
author: Wendy_F

title: Well Worth the money
text: Marina was an outstanding tour host.  Excellent experience. We would highly recommend. Ride was easy on e-bikes. Sites were fantastic.
author: Shannon_S

title: Very fun e bike tour
text: We had a wonderful private tour lead by Igor. He was extremely knowledgeable and friendly and we enjoyed the tour very much. I would highly recommend the tour and if your lucky, Igor will be your guide.
author: Dlopes

title: An Amazing Family Experience on Montjuïc!
text:
We went on the Montjuïc tour with our family, and it was absolutely wonderful! The route was well-planned, offering incredible views and interesting stops along the way.

What made the experience extra special was our guide—so friendly, knowledgeable, and engaging! They made sure everyone, including the kids, had a great time.

And the tapas stop? Just perfect! Delicious food, a cozy atmosphere, and a chance to relax before continuing the tour.

It was a memorable day for our whole family, and we highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: 75evgenyl
